Delete a project and everything in it: its keys, catalog, people, purchases and analytics. This
cannot be undone. Asks you to type its name; --yes skips that.

Usage:
  voidhash project delete [project] [flags]

Arguments:
  project  The project's slug, organization/slug, name or id (default: this directory's project,
           then your default project)

Flags:
  -h, --help   Show help for this command
      --json   Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
  -q, --quiet  Print only ids, one per line
  -y, --yes    Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash project delete acme/web
  voidhash project delete acme/web --yes
